browse_api.description:
Herb Alpert – Rise – A&M Records SP-4790 – 1979 Vinyl LP

Classic 1979 album from trumpeter Herb Alpert, blending jazz, funk, soul, Latin influences and polished late-'70s production.

Includes:

  • Rise
  • Rotation
  • Behind the Rain
  • Street Life
  • Love Is
  • Angelina
  • Aranjuez (Mon Amour)
  • 1980

The title track “Rise” became one of Herb Alpert’s signature recordings, and the album reached No. 6 on both the Billboard 200 and Billboard R&B Albums charts.

Catalog Number: SP-4790
